seoTitle: Manchester United Ferry | Boat to Old Trafford | Matchday Ferry Service
seoDescription: Travel to Old Trafford by boat. Matchday ferry service from Salford Quays direct to Old Trafford — the best way to arrive on matchday.
heading: MUFC Ferry Service
intro: Beat the matchday traffic and travel to Old Trafford by boat. Choose your departure point — both routes arrive at Trafford Wharf, a short walk from the ground.

sections.heading: Choose your departure point
body: Both ferry routes arrive at Trafford Wharf, at the stadium end beside IWM North — just a short walk from Old Trafford. Pick whichever departure point suits you best.

sections.heading: The route at a glance
body: Two departure points, one destination. The map shows both departure points, the arrival at Trafford Wharf and Old Trafford itself.

items.question: Where does the ferry arrive?
items.answer: Both routes arrive at Trafford Wharf, at the stadium end beside IWM North — a short walk from Old Trafford.

items.question: Which departure point should I choose?
items.answer: Choose whichever is most convenient for you: Ralli Quay (River Irwell near New Bailey, Salford) or Stephenson's Bridge (near Water Street). Both arrive at the same place.

items.question: How long does the crossing take?
Does the ferry run for every match?
items.answer: The ferry runs on selected matchdays only. Check availability for your fixture when booking. (TBC)

items.question: Is there a return service after the game?
items.answer: Yes — the ferry returns from Trafford Wharf after the final whistle. Return boarding details TBC.

items.question: Can I hire a boat for a private group on matchday?
items.answer: Yes — private matchday hire is available for groups. Get in touch to enquire.
